steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0010_stage2_safeguarded_training is completed and produced the checkpoints under investigation.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create task folder structure and initial files.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Not included: this is an empirical debugging/forensics task (checkpoint loading, weight inspection, audio inference), not a literature question. No published-paper evidence bears on the root cause.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Not included: task_description.md already specifies the exact reproduction recipe (torch pin, StyleTTS2 demo notebook, dependency list) discovered in the prior ad hoc session; no new external research is needed to execute it.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0010's code, config (config_david_v10.yml), checkpoint layout, and the kokoro-format packaging step to understand how the raw StyleTTS2 checkpoint and the packaged asset differ before building the inference harness.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the instrumented-harness build, control test, v10 diagnosis, and root-cause write-up as a sequenced multi-step plan with verification criteria at each stage.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Not included: task_description.md specifies a CPU-only venv reproduction (torch==2.5.1 CPU, espeak-ng, local StyleTTS2 inference) with no GPU training or large-scale inference involved.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build the CPU kikiri-tts/StyleTTS2 venv, write the instrumented inference recipe, run the control checkpoint test, then diagnose epoch_2nd_00016.pth and epoch_2nd_00014.pth; save all audio and instrumentation logs.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Not included: no remote machine was provisioned (setup-machines not included), so there is nothing to tear down.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Consider alternative diagnostic angles beyond the scripted checklist (e.g. other failure classes the missing/unexpected-key and weight-norm checks might miss) before finalizing the root cause.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write control_test.md, v10_diagnosis.md, results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, and metrics.json with the root cause and recommendation.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Not included: this task produces internal forensic evidence (key-load diagnostics, weight-norm comparisons, audio checks) about one project's own checkpoints, not quantitative results comparable to a published baseline.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Formulate follow-up suggestions, in particular the eval-harness regression-check follow-up called out in the task description.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Final verification pass, session capture, and reporting.
